steps.text: L-Let's stop here. This mountain road is so twisty that if we keep driving, we might actually end up closer to those clouds.

spans.text: L-Let's stop here. This mountain road is so twisty that if we keep driving, we might actually end up

steps.text: Look, everyone else's stopped by the side of the road. There's nothing we can do but pray for the Catastrophe to float past us.
Ning-Ning, don't stick your head out the window. Just hold onto this talisman and keep yourself hidden.
Mom, Dad, is that really... a Catastrophe? B-But... why didn't the Catastrophe Messenger warn us?
Well, there are some disasters not even the Catastrophe Messengers can foresee.
Don't you worry, though, we'll be just fine... You'll get to grow up, Ning-Ning, as happy and peaceful as can be.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Woah... The wind's so strong...

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: The good news is that the snow's stopped, and once the weather clears up, our search and rescue operation will go much easier.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: We're responding to a request by the Chamber of Commerce. According to their information, the last signal from the missing caravan came from their temporary winter camp, two hundred li to the north.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: But following the snowstorm last night, communications with the camp were cut off, and we've been tasked with confirming the situation.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Everyone, please double-check your equipment and confirm the condition of your protective gear.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: If there are no issues, load everything into the cars. The roads are slippery after it snows, so plan your route accordingly.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Um, excuse me, am I bringing enough emergency supplies to deal with frostbite and hypothermia?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I don't have much practical experience, so I could only go by the textbook, but I'm not sure if I've overlooked anything...

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: This is your first formal rescue operation, right?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Y-Yes! I'll do my best not to be a burden.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Haha, don't be so nervous. If you've already passed the training course and become a full-fledged member of Chun-qian, you should be more than prepared for this.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: O-Okay.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: ...Mhm, see, you've got plenty of all the right medicine and equipment.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: What's this, by the way?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, um, that's a letter.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: When we left, you said that no matter how simple the operation might seem, we must always be prepared for the possibility of not making it back... So, um, I decided to write a letter to my parents.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Oh. I didn't mean it that seriously. But still, it's better to be prepared for the worst than not.

spans.text: seriously. But still, it's better to be prepared for the worst than not.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...Hwah?

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Feel that? My hands are pretty darn hot, right? My Originium Arts let me produce a little bit of heat.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: I noticed you've been shivering this whole time. Feeling a bit warmer now?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, umm... Yes, but actually, that wasn't because of the cold...

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Haha, don't worry about it. No need to thank me. If you're feeling better now, then let's get going.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: The current wind conditions will seriously impact the operation. When heading into the mountains for search and rescue, be sure to closely follow the guidelines and avoid making any rash decisions.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Captain, the snow's starting to pick back up again! This is nothing like the weather forecast!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: The temporary camp is right around the corner. Once we reach it, we'll need to repair the comms station and confirm the situation with HQ.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: But, if this poor weather persists...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...We might have to put the operation on hold.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Mhm. It'll delay our entrance into the camp.
Anybody... Is anybody there? ...Help...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, over there!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...The rescue team? I, I made it long enough for help to arrive?

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...Please! Save my parents! And the others from the caravan! They're still trapped under the snow!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Don't worry. We're here to help.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Ning-Ning, he has signs of severe frostbite and needs both first-aid and food. Also check him for any fractures since there are signs of having taken a fall.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Right away!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Alright, you can relax now. Can you tell me where the other members of the caravan are?

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: (Shakes head forcefully)

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...I don't know. Everyone got separated during the blizzard. I walked what seemed like forever, and finally found my way back to the camp alone.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: No idea what happened to anyone else...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Um, to the best of your knowledge, did the blizzard cause an avalanche nearby?

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I... don't think so? I didn't hear anything like that.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: But... I can't say for sure... The wind was so loud, I could've missed it...

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: No, I'm sure they're still alive! They're all experienced caravanners! There's no way I'd be the only survivor!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The squad leader isn't saying anything.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The fierce wind is... so, so cold. My teeth won't stop chattering.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (With the current visibility, there's no way we'd be able to search for victims, not to mention the risks of heading deeper into the mountains.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (We can't fly any drones out there, we can't rely on radio signal scans, and we won't be able to see much with our searchlights.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (But if they are experienced caravanners, they must've done what they could to send out distress signals.)

spans.text: experienced caravanners, they must've done what they could to send out distress signals.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (If they've been consciously making signal banners, or carrying survival whistles and signal lights with them, they have a very good chance of being found.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Hey, don't get up yet! I'm not done with the check-up!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I'm already feeling better. I have to go look for them.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: No, don't! You've only just barely warmed up a little!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Also, you've sprained both your ankles! The only reason you don't feel anything is because of how badly frozen they are! Now sit back down!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I'm fine, I can handle myself. If you're not going to go rescue them, then I will.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Urgh...!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: C-Captain, I've gotten the patient under control!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: But what should we do...? The missing people are still out there, waiting for our help.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: ...Is the communication base station back in operation yet?

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Hold on... I'm getting a signal.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Captain, we've managed to make contact with HQ, but the signal is extremely unstable.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: According to HQ's observational analysis, the snowfall will decrease over the next two hours, but beyond that, they can't say for sure.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: That's good enough.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Ning-Ning, stay here and keep an eye on the base station. Fix up the tents around the camp, and move the wounded inside.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Use the transceiver to stay in contact with us. We'll need to make decisions on-the-fly depending on the information we get from HQ.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: U-Understood!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Then, umm...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Come back safe.
Black rocks fall, carving a gash into the mountain.
Sand and stone pour from it like a waterfall, the terrible noise echoing through the valley.
The girl covers her mouth, blankly looking on as the cars on the road across the valley and the houses at the foot of the mountain all become submerged beneath the torrent of falling rocks.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Phew... That should do it.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Once the herbs take effect, the swelling should go down quickly. Your body temperature has already more or less returned to normal.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, and you've been in starvation conditions for so long that your stomach might not be able to handle solid food right away. Let's get you a nutrient solution first, to at least restore your energy.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: We've also managed to restore comms with HQ, so all we have to do now is wait.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Mm... Thank you.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (...The captain let me stay behind because she saw right away how scared I was.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (Of course, I realize my role here is important too, and someone has to do it. I don't have enough experience in making snap decisions, so I'm not suited for heading out in such dangerous conditions.)

spans.text: (Of course, I realize my role here is important too, and
has to do it. I don't have enough experience in making snap decisions, so I'm not suited for heading out in such dangerous conditions.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (But when I heard her give the order, my first reaction wasn't disappointment, but... relief.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (How can I call myself part of the rescue team like this? What do I have to show my parents, to prove I can go down this career path?)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, um! Excuse me!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: S-Sorry! Please don't go to sleep just yet!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: We don't have any monitoring equipment on hand, so I have to directly observe your condition for the time being.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Oh... Okay. I'm just... really tired. I don't... want to sleep either.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: If I fall asleep now, I know I'll have nothing but nightmares.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Then, um, let's chat a little. My job is just to make sure the communication equipment stays stable, so it won't distract me or anything.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: That's... not a very encouraging expression.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: You're a professional, so give me your honest opinion. It's too late for the others, isn't it?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Huh? N-No, that's not it... A-Actually, I was thinking of something else entirely.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I'm sorry, I can't believe I let my mind wander at a time like this.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Oh, no, I'm the one who should be apologizing.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I can't exactly keep a cool head either. I even blew up at you earlier.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I... I'm just really, really scared.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: To be honest, I wanted to prove that I was capable, that I wouldn't hold my parents back. That's why I insisted on going into these snowy mountains with their caravan.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: So, if something happened to them... wouldn't that make everything my fault?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Um, I think... nobody's to blame for the heavy snowfall.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: But still, I can't help but think that I'm responsible for all this.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: If not... who else could I blame? God?

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...The wind sure is harsh.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Mhm... It sure is.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Actually... I think I can relate a little. My parents didn't want me taking this job either. They said it was dangerous, what with how 'the elements are unpredictable,' and all that.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: So I snuck off by myself. All this time, and they haven't even sent me a single letter.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: If something were to happen to me, and the letter I left taken back to my hometown... To be honest, I have no idea how they'd react.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...I don't want to think about it either.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Ning-Ning! Ning-Ning! Do you read me?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Ah, yes, I'm here!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Please report back to HQ: We've found traces of entrapment under deep snow, with thermal imaging signatures from beneath. No response to calls.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: We need HQ to help us come up with a rescue plan.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Temperature... Wind speed... Entrapment depth... Snowfall conditions... Okay, I've got everything!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I just contacted HQ, and members from the rear technical team should be on duty right now, so I'll pass on the message!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Also, the snow will intensify again partway through the night, so make sure to come back in time.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Did you hear that? The northwestern team seems to have found someone!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...Oh, asleep already? I hope I wasn't talking too loud.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Mm, his vital signs are stable, so it should be fine.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: He's earned his rest.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Now to call HQ—

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Crap, crap! The signal cut off! That gust of wind just now must've interfered with the base station...
Gu Ning-Ning cannot help but cast a glance at the sleeping victim, and then at the wireless transceiver in her hand.
She is now completely alone, alone with the howling wind.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (Shakes head forcefully) Stop trembling! Don't you dare! Don't you dare think about calling the others back to bail you out either!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Forget these unnecessary thoughts. Tell everyone there's been an interruption in the signal, then hurry up and fix it!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: *exhales*... Okay. Searchlight, protective goggles, non-slip gloves, safety rope. No problems there. This situation was explained in the manual.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Next up is...
Gu Ning-Ning takes out the letter from her luggage and slips it into her pocket.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The camp is sheltered from the wind, but the base station is atop a hill... If I'm remembering right, it should be this way.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (Ugh... The wind is so strong that I can't see anything but blowing snow in front of me.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (Oh no... That means the people still out there are in even more danger!)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (That's why... I, I absolutely can't panic. If I mess this up... If I make any sort of mistake...)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (No, stop it! Just watch your step, and don't let your eyes wander!)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...Oh, I think I see the outline of the base station. Good, the damage doesn't look too severe.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: C-Captain! Reporting in!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: There's no sign of external damage to the base station! I'll go check on the antenna!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Good. Be careful when climbing up there.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Phew... Checking the fulcrum, adjusting the position of the safety rope...

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (It's freezing...)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The moment I looked up, my goggles were completely covered with snow, and I can't see anything...)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (How much further is the top of the tower? How long have I been climbing? In training, I've climbed dozens of meters, but it never felt this long...)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The support... is it about to get blown over by the wind? Or is that just my legs shaking?)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The transceiver keeps beeping. It should be the teams confirming their safety with one another. If I waste any more time here, am I putting them all in danger...?)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (No, no! What am I thinking? I'm not nervous, I'm not nervous...)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (I just need to figure out how to solve this problem. That's right, I can fix this!)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (The safety rope is secure. I double-checked it before I started.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (If I slip, I just need to make sure I control my bearings, to minimize the risk of sliding down the hill.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: (Just stay focused and take it one step at a time. Everything will be fine.)

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...I feel it! Reporting in, Captain! I've reached the top!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Now checking the fault light prompts to determine the position of the failed circuitry!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Good. I'm here to assist you in remote troubleshooting if you need it.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: U-Understood!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Don't panic. We're all relatively safe for now. The second team has located two missing persons and brought them back to camp.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Once you're back, you can divvy up the workload.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: You're doing a great job.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...Okay!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Phew, I've managed to calm this lady down too.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: None of the rescue victims seem to be in critical condition, which is great news.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh, the sun's rising.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: The weather will be clearing up shortly too. Once the sun's out, our rescue operations will be significantly easier.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Member
steps.text: Hah! I'm feeling motivated again! Let me head out with the third team and see what the situation's like.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Okay, please be careful!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...They're still not back yet?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: P-Please don't get up and walk on your own! I only applied emergency treatment; you'll still have to rest so your injuries can heal.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I'm sure one of us in Chun-qian will bring back good news soon, so please hold on a bit longer.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: How long has it been since you guys last slept?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Huh? Umm... Just one all-nighter? It's totally fine. With how dire the situation's been, it's not like I'd be able to sleep anyway.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Besides, saving lives is more important. I think everyone's been pretty tense. Even the ones in HQ's support team haven't had time to rest.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: But don't worry, we won't mess this rescue operation up!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Mm... Thank you.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: By the way, why did you decide to join the rescue squad? To prove yourself to your parents?

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Umm, no, that's not it... It's because when I was very little, I saw a Catastrophe firsthand.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: But... I don't actually remember what was going through my head at the time. After all, Catastrophes are still terrifying to me, even now...

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Ning-Ning, prepare the warming measures!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Okay, got it!

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Be careful when moving these two into their sleeping bags. We did our best to keep them warm in the open air, but they're still extremely frail.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: —Father! Mother!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: So those are your parents! That's great!

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Thank you so much! Thank you!

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: We... managed to save these people.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Right, back then...

The girl thought her father would soon reach over to cover her eyes with his large hand; that her mother would tell her how terrible Catastrophes are, and that children ought not see or think about them lest they have nightmares.
But instead, they sighed and took her hand.
'Ning-Ning, just remembering these Catastrophes is already a very brave thing to do.'

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: The only thing I could think of back then was... how scared I was. Sad. Powerless. But I still wanted to remember. I wanted to make the misery brought by calamity less painful.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: ...That's what my mom and dad taught me.

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: ...Father, Mother, can you hear me?

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: I'll rub your hands for you, you'll warm up in no time...

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: Please stay calm and let us handle the first aid. Your parents still need to rest and recover before they'll be able to respond to you.

steps.name: Rescue Squad Leader
steps.text: And that should pretty much wrap up our search and rescue operation. Judging from the other teams' reports, they've located all the missing persons, choosing the most effective rescue methods for each situation.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: That's fantastic... Looks like this letter won't be needed either.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Phew... Finally, a moment of relief.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Oh right... Excuse me...

steps.name: Young Victim
steps.text: Yes?
Gu Ning-Ning opens the envelope with her home address written on it.
There is nothing inside except for a small talisman.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: Um, th-this is a kind of protective charm, like a prayer for peace and prosperity.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I hope that you, your parents, and everyone else in the caravan can have a speedy recovery.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: I was planning on bringing it back with me, but I think it'd be better to pass this hope on.

steps.name: Gu Ning-Ning
steps.text: And instead... I should probably write a proper letter.
